title: coronilla scorpioides var. repanda
intro: Coronilla scorpioides var. repanda, commonly known as Bird's Foot Clover, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the pea family (Fabaceae). The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs, as well as its ability to act as a natural diuretic. Coronilla scorpioides var. repanda is also known to possess therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
